meta.titulo: Used Porsche 718 Boxster and Cayman for sale · Valentín Motors
meta.descripcion: Porsche 718 Boxster and Cayman type 982, from 2016, inspected on 111 points: turbo four-cylinders or naturally aspirated sixes in GTS 4.0, Spyder and GT4. Twelve-month warranty.

parrafos: The 718 renews Boxster and Cayman with turbocharged four-cylinder engines: 2.0 with 300 hp and 2.5 with 350 in the S and 365 in the GTS. In 2019 the naturally aspirated six returns with the 4.0 giving 400 hp in the GTS 4.0 and 420 in the Spyder and Cayman GT4, and with it come back the waiting lists.
The four-cylinder cars are fast, frugal and buy well used; the 4.0 cars are the ones the market chases. In both cases it pays to look at the remaining warranty and how the car has been used.

secciones.titulo: What we check on a 718 before selling it
items: Factory or Porsche Approved warranty: how much remains and on what terms it transfers.
Service history within the Porsche network and service campaigns carried out.
Turbo engine: boost pressure, intercooler and leaks; on the 4.0, oil consumption and cold noises.
PDK or manual, brakes, tyres and wheels: condition, dates and damage.
On Spyder and GT4: track use, replaced components and originality.

parrafos: Every Porsche 718 Boxster and Cayman we sell goes through our 111-point inspection, leaves with a twelve-month or 10,000 km warranty on engine and gearbox, and its certified mileage is stated on the sales invoice. We have been Porsche specialists since 1979, with our own workshops in Barcelona and Madrid: the car you buy here has been on our lift before it reaches your hands.
If you have found the one you want elsewhere, we can also check it for you before you pay for it: pre-purchase inspection.
